Glycosylation defect affecting neuromuscular transmission; intrinsic muscle pathology in 2/2 and weakness in 4/4; retinoschisis in 2/4 supports ocular involvement.
Inherited manganese handling disorder with dystonia; hepatic disease and polycythemia are subtype-specific rather than established across most of the umbrella.
UPF3B-related intellectual developmental disorder; facial dysmorphism does not establish functional skeletal damage; scoliosis in 3/11 is below 30%.
Necrosis of dental pulp; teeth belong to gastrointestinal. Bacterial infection is not required.
Inherited cerebral folate transport defect causing neurodegeneration, regression and seizures.
SHH-activated medulloblastoma is a primary cerebellar malignancy.
Hereditary syndrome defined by cutaneous melanoma and neural system tumors, typically astrocytoma; no additional organs inferred from cancer susceptibility.
Congenital rubella: hearing loss and cataracts 80-99%; cardiac defects are major criteria and 30-79%. Neurologic and hematologic injury also frequent, omitted at cap.
Pathological calcium deposition classified as calcium metabolic disease; no single tissue site or functional organ injury is common across this umbrella.
Inherited sideroblastic anemia with ring sideroblasts, thrombocytopenia and neutropenia; all supplied manifestations are hematologic.
Combined immunodeficiency; neutropenia in 2/2, vitiligo and alopecia in 1/2. Recurrent infections, diarrhea and hepatomegaly alone do not establish other organ damage.
Neonatal epilepsy syndrome, usually remitting with favorable neurological outcome.
Hereditary cancer syndrome defined by diffuse gastric cancer and lobular breast cancer; stomach is gastrointestinal and breast has no axis.
Segmental lower motor neuron degeneration causes upper limb weakness and wasting; no independent intrinsic muscle disorder established.
Mitochondrial complex II defect; neurodegeneration, cardiomyopathy and optic disc pallor with visual impairment each reported in 1/1 phenotyped patient; tiny cohort.
Tyrosinase-dependent melanin synthesis defect defines skin and hair depigmentation and ocular developmental dysfunction; optic pathway findings belong to ocular.
Defined by variable marrow failure/thrombocytopenia and radioulnar synostosis. Cardiac, renal, immune and hearing abnormalities lack evidence of involvement in most patients.
Adenoid histological variant of cutaneous basal cell carcinoma; the anomalous cervical child does not change this concept's skin origin.
TTC8-related retinitis pigmentosa with rod-cone degeneration in 4/4; no syndromic extraocular damage established.
Severe congenital brain malformation; retinal dysplasia in 2/2 supports ocular injury and craniosynostosis in 2/2 supports skeletal involvement.
Chronic respiratory disease, malabsorption and cataracts define syndrome; progressive end-stage renal disease in both reported sibs. Otologic involvement omitted at cap.
Papillary adenocarcinoma arising in the stomach.
Isolated congenital growth hormone deficiency with pituitary hypoplasia; short stature and delayed skeletal maturation do not establish separate skeletal injury.
Congenital skeletal malformation with supernumerary digits; extraorgan features of individual syndromes do not apply across the umbrella.
